question: बाल श्रमिकले वर्षमा कति दिन सार्वजनिक बिदा पाउँछ?
response_text:
बालश्रममा संलग्न बालबालिकाले वर्षमा कम्तीमा १३ दिन पूर्ण तलबसहितको सार्वजनिक बिदा पाउने व्यवस्था नियम ८ मा गरिएको छ [1] ।

यो कुरा पुष्टि गर्न सकिएन
- के कानुनले बालश्रमिकलाई वयस्क कामदार सरहको सार्वजनिक बिदा दिन्छ कि दिँदैन भन्ने कुरा पुष्टि हुन सकेन ।

सावधानी:
प्रमाणले 'नियम ८' को उल्लेख गरे पनि यो नियम कुन ऐन, अध्यादेश वा नियमावली अन्तर्गत पर्दछ भन्ने स्पष्ट जानकारी दिएको छैन ।

[source: https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/nep187179.pdf]
Rule 9. Home Leave: (1) A child working in an Enterprise shall be entitled to paid home leave at the rate of One day for every twenty days of the period of work performed by him/her. The home leave to be enjoyed pursuant to Sub-rule (1) may be accumulated for a maximum period of Thirty Six days.

[source: https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/nep187179.pdf]
Rule 4. Certificate of Eligibility: (1) Before employing a child as a Labour, an application shall be filed in the Labour office to examine his/her health in relation to his/her ability and inability to do the work, mentioning about the nature of the work and the age of the child. (2) After obtaining an application pursuant to Sub-rule (1), the Labour Office shall cause a doctor to examine the health of the child. (3) If on an examination done pursuant to Sub-rule (1), the child is found to be capable for the work, the doctor shall provide a certificate of eligibility pursuant to the Schedule.
